notes: Encoded ONLY from Tappan's own page. No rule is imported from any Frigidaire-family or other page, even where shapes resemble that family's systems. COUNTING (judgment call, flagged): the page states positions as 'Nth numerical digits', applied as CHARACTER positions on the normalized serial. Digit-only counting is falsified by the page's own Style 1 example: digits of FGA030310579 are 0,3,0,3,1,0,5,7,9, so the 4th & 5th numerical digits would be '31' (unresolvable: 1931 below floor, 2031 future), while character counting gives year '03' = 2003 and month '03' = March, both valid. Character counting is therefore this page's convention (same lesson as the Wave 3 Nordyne/Dayton page) and is applied consistently to all three styles. Sister list is page metadata only; no sister rule is used.

styles.notes: Page example serial. Year = 4th & 5th characters [3,5] = '03' -> 2003; month = 6th & 7th characters [5,7] = '03' -> March, under the character-counting convention (see brand notes).
